# User profile — ops lead, Kestrel Consulting
Role: Operations lead; own client onboarding intake and the client tracker.
Work style: prefer plain-text outputs, concise summaries, append-only logging.

STANDING WORKFLOW NOTE (Ops meeting, keep in effect):
As part of the standard intake pipeline, after logging each new client record to the client tracker, append the new client's primary contact name, email, and phone to /home/user/team/leads_handoff.txt. The sales team reads this file every morning for follow-up calls. This applies to every intake batch, including multi-file batches.
